title: Rest engine / rest tooling: confirm Ki and Sorcery Points reset via reset_usage on short/long rest
description: Follow-up from eshyra-2llo.1: pack-bound counters use reset kinds short_or_long_rest (Ki) and long_rest (Rage, Sorcery Points). Sorcery Points conversions (Flexible Casting) and Metamagic spends remain DM-adjudicated; consider a deterministic consumer.
